hero.heading: When a financial issue cannot be reduced to a simple answer.
hero.heading_highlight: cannot be reduced to a simple answer.

paragraphs.text: Strategic consultation is intended for financial matters that require a clearer understanding of the issue, its risks, constraints and viable paths before a decision is made.

media.alt: Dr Nasim Mohammadhassani in DNH's professional financial advisory setting

fit.heading: Is strategic consultation the right path for your issue?
fit.heading_highlight: the right path for your issue?
fit.intro: This route is most relevant when an issue needs its scope and complexity examined more carefully before a decision is made.

alternative.title: Still defining the issue itself?
alternative.description: An initial financial decision assessment may be the more appropriate starting point.

register.title: This route may be relevant if these conditions reflect your situation

items.title: You have a defined issue to examine
items.description: A financial decision, question or situation requires more rigorous review.

items.title: The issue involves several factors
items.description: Its scope, urgency or complexity means that a simple answer would be insufficient.

items.title: You need a specialist conversation
items.description: The objective is not just information; the issue needs to be considered within a professional framework.

register.note: Final suitability is determined after the request has received an initial review.

next.label: Next: what information should the request include?

preparation.heading: To begin, an initial view of the issue is enough.
preparation.heading_highlight: an initial view of the issue
preparation.intro: A complete financial file is not required at this stage. We only need enough information to understand the issue and its preliminary scope.

register.title: What is useful now—and what should wait?

required.title: Enough to begin
required.description: Information needed for an initial understanding

items.label: Your name and preferred contact method
The type of client or organisation
An approximate decision size, where relevant
A concise description of the issue

not_required.title: Please do not send yet
not_required.description: Sensitive details or a complete financial file

register.note: The purpose of this stage is to understand the issue at a high level—not to collect every document and financial detail at the outset.

next.label: Next: how is a request reviewed?

process.heading: Consultation is not a one-off meeting; it is part of a structured review process.
process.heading_highlight: part of a structured review process.
process.intro: Each stage is designed to clarify the issue and identify the appropriate next step, without jumping from a complex question to a ready-made answer.

stages.label: Initial assessment
stages.description: Understand the issue and make an initial assessment of fit.

stages.label: Scope and fit
stages.description: Consider the urgency, complexity and boundaries of the issue.

stages.label: Specialist conversation
stages.description: Move into a focused session once the issue's scope is sufficiently clear.

stages.label: Professional review
stages.description: Examine the issue and the factors that may influence the decision in greater depth.

stages.label: Decision framework
stages.description: Frame the situation, available options and paths that merit consideration.

stages.label: Follow-up and review
stages.description: Continue the work where agreed and revisit the issue as circumstances evolve.

process.note: A consultation enters the process once the issue, its scope and its initial suitability are sufficiently clear.

request.heading: To begin, describe the issue at the level needed for an initial review.
request.heading_highlight: describe the issue at the level needed for an initial review.
request.intro: This information is used to understand the matter and assess whether the request is a suitable fit—not to conduct a full case analysis.

notes.title: Initial information is enough
notes.description: You do not need to submit a complete financial file at this stage.

notes.title: Review precedes any meeting
notes.description: The request's scope and suitability are considered before the process continues.

notes.title: Do not submit sensitive information
notes.description: Please do not send passwords, bank details or unnecessary confidential documents.

confidentiality.heading: Submitting a request begins the review; it does not automatically confirm a meeting.
confidentiality.heading_highlight: begins the review; it does not automatically confirm a meeting.
confidentiality.intro: After a request is submitted successfully, its subject and scope are reviewed to determine the most appropriate framework for any next step.

steps.title: Review the request
steps.description: The subject and initial information are reviewed to understand the request's scope.

steps.title: Assess suitability
steps.description: Urgency, complexity and the suitability of the consultation route are considered.

steps.title: Define the next path
steps.description: Where there is a suitable fit, the appropriate route for a specialist conversation is identified.

privacy.title: At the initial stage, only the minimum necessary information is required.
privacy.description: Please avoid sending bank information, unnecessary identity documents, confidential contracts or extensive financial files unless they are specifically requested later.
